answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, no identity may audit its own recruit. The lantern of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the cedar of a task receipt, and the mirror is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
